title: xochiquetzallia mortoniana
intro:
Xochiquetzallia mortoniana, commonly known as the Mexican feather grass, is a type of flowering plant native to Mexico. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, due to its health benefits.
